## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./...` and `go test -race ./...` pass
- [ ] New behaviour or a fixed bug has a test
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or config changed
- [ ] No tokens, chat or user IDs, or personal paths in code, docs or test data
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: …`, `fix: …`)
